views.name: qualifying_q2_milliseconds
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  qualifyId,
  raceId,
  driverId,
  q2,
  CASE
    WHEN q2 GLOB '*:*.*' THEN
      -- format M:SS.mmm or MM:SS.mmm
      (
        CAST(substr(q2, 1, instr(q2, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(
            replace(
              substr(q2, instr(q2, ':')+1),
              '.', ''
            ) AS INTEGER
          )
      )
    WHEN q2 GLOB '*:*' THEN
      -- format M:SS or MM:SS (no milliseconds)
      (
        CAST(substr(q2, 1, instr(q2, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(substr(q2, instr(q2, ':')+1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      )
    WHEN q2 GLOB '*.*' THEN
      -- format S.mmm or SS.mmm (seconds with decimal)
      (
        CAST(substr(q2, 1, instr(q2, '.')-1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(substr(q2, instr(q2, '.')+1) AS INTEGER)
      )
    WHEN q2 NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%' AND q2 != '' THEN
      -- pure milliseconds integer string
      CAST(q2 AS INTEGER)
    ELSE
      NULL
  END AS q2_milliseconds
FROM qualifying_rows
WHERE q2 IS NOT NULL
grain: qualifyId  -- one row per qualifying record with q2 parsed
views.description: Normalized qualifying q2 times converted to integer milliseconds when q2 is present and parsable. Keeps original q2 text and exposes parsed milliseconds to enable numeric sorting and min()/max() operations.

views.name: race_results_with_speed
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  r.driverId,
  r.constructorId,
  r.position,
  r.points,
  r.fastestLap AS fastestLap,
  r.fastestLapSpeed AS fastestLapSpeed_raw,
  -- normalize fastestLapSpeed: try to cast numeric text to REAL; remove non-numeric characters like ' km/h' if present
  CASE
    WHEN r.fastestLapSpeed IS NULL OR trim(r.fastestLapSpeed) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- remove common suffixes and commas, then cast; fallback to NULL on failure
      CAST(
        replace(
          replace(
            replace(
              replace(trim(r.fastestLapSpeed), 'km/h', ''),
            'KM/H', ''),
          'kph', ''),
        ',', '') AS REAL)
  END AS fastestLapSpeed
FROM results r
views.description: Race-level results with fastest lap speed normalized to numeric. Exposes result identity, race, driver, constructor, and parsed fastest lap speed for numeric comparisons.

views.name: driver_race_completion_candidates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.raceId AS raceId,
  d.driverId AS driverId,
  COUNT(res.resultId) AS total_entries,
  SUM(CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(res.time) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_entries
FROM
  results res
JOIN
  races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN
  drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY
  r.raceId,
  d.driverId
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts per driver per race of total result entries and completed entries (where results.time is non-NULL and not empty). Useful to compute completion rates per driver per race.

views.name: races_core_52
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  races.raceId AS raceId,
  races.name AS name,
  -- normalize empty strings to NULL for date/time
  NULLIF(races.date, '') AS date,
  NULLIF(races.time, '') AS time,
  races.year AS year,
  -- extract month number from date if present
  CASE
    WHEN races.date IS NOT NULL AND races.date != '' THEN CAST(strftime('%m', races.date) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS month,
  races.circuitId AS circuitId
FROM races
WHERE races.date IS NOT NULL AND races.date != ''
views.description: One-row-per-race canonical projection with parsed year/month and null-cleaned date/time fields to support date-based filtering and joins.

  country,
  lat,
  lng,
  alt
FROM circuits
views.description: Canonical lookup of circuits (identifiers and descriptive attributes) for joining to races or geographic filtering.

views.name: races_min_date_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MIN(date) AS min_date,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(date)) AS INTEGER) AS min_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', MIN(date)) AS INTEGER) AS min_month
FROM races
WHERE date IS NOT NULL
grain: single-row aggregate (global earliest race date among non-null dates)

semantic_filters.min_date: derived as MIN(date) WHERE date IS NOT NULL

views.description: Aggregate summary to compute the earliest non-null race date; exposes the min_date and its computed year and month for reuse in date-equality filters.

views.name: race_results_raw

views.description: Normalized row-level race results per driver per race. Keeps keys and raw measures (points, position, time, laps, fastest lap info) for joining, aggregation, and filtering.

views.description: Aggregated points measures per driver computed from results rows. Exposes raw aggregates so callers can pick max single-result points or total/average across races.

views.name: race_identity

views.name: drivers_core_65

views.name: results_with_race_and_driver
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.resultId,
  r.raceId,
  ra.year,
  r.driverId,
  d.surname,
  r.position,
  r.positionText,
  r.points,
  r.statusId
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
views.description: Denormalized result rows joined to race and driver basic info. One row per result entry, with result position and points and linked race year and driver surname for easy cohorting and aggregation.

views.name: drivers_core_67
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driverId,
  driverRef,
  forename,
  surname,
  -- canonical full name: forename + ' ' + surname, handle NULLs
  (CASE
     WHEN forename IS NOT NULL AND surname IS NOT NULL THEN forename || ' ' || surname
     WHEN forename IS NOT NULL THEN forename
     WHEN surname IS NOT NULL THEN surname
     ELSE NULL
   END) AS full_name,
  number,
  code,
  dob,
  nationality,
  url
FROM drivers
views.description: Canonical driver dimension with stable identifiers and cleaned name fields useful for joins and display.

views.name: driver_standings_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT

  driverStandings.raceId AS raceId,
  driverStandings.driverId AS driverId,
  driverStandings.points AS points,
  driverStandings.position AS position,
  driverStandings.positionText AS positionText,
  driverStandings.wins AS wins
FROM driverStandings
grain: one row per driverStandings.driverStandingsId (driver-season/race standing entry)
views.description: Row-level driver standings facts (one row per driver-standings entry) exposing wins and points for aggregation and analysis.

views.name: driver_wins_and_points_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ds.driverId AS driverId,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ds.wins IS NOT NULL THEN ds.wins ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_wins,
  MAX(ds.points) AS max_points,
  COUNT(*) AS standings_rows_count
FROM driverStandings ds
GROUP BY ds.driverId
views.description: Aggregated driver-level measures: total wins and maximum points across all their standings entries. Keeps driverId as key so it can be joined to driver dimension or further filtered.

views.name: drivers_core_70
